title: South Africa Women vs Cardiff – WXV Opener Preview & Betting Insight
flags: Veteran players such as **Mpho Mpho** and **Thulani Maseko** will bring experience to the mix.
For South Africa, the experienced striker **Thulani Maseko** is a likely candidate to hit the net if the defense cracks.
The WXV, the newest global women’s tournament created by FIFA, has just kicked off its first round.

The WXV features 12 national teams divided into three groups of four. The top teams advance to the semi‑finals, while the rest play placement matches. The tournament aims to give women’s football a global spotlight.
